pool.text: The Haji Ali Dargah in Worli was erected honoring the Sufi saint.
The islands were ceded to the Portuguese by the treaty.
The islands were transferred to the British Crown as dowry.
The English Crown leased these islands to the East India Company.
The East India Company transferred its headquarters from Surat to Bombay.
Mumbai underwent major transformation through the Hornby Vellard project reclamation.
Bombay became the capital of Bombay State after independence.
Bombay State was reorganized along linguistic lines creating Maharashtra.
The Shiv Sena was formed out of resentment about marginalisation.
The government established the Bombay Metropolitan Region Development Authority.
New Bombay was established as a planned satellite township.
Jawaharlal Nehru Port was commissioned on May 26 as a major port.
The Jawaharlal Nehru Port was commissioned at Nhava Sheva.
The Government of India officially changed the English name.
BEST introduced air-conditioned buses to its fleet.
The Mumbai–Pune Expressway opened as the first expressway in India.
MTNL held a monopoly over fixed line and cellular services until this time.
The Conditional Access System started by the Union Government met a poor response.
Mumbai employed a large percentage of the nation's factory workforce.
The city required a daily supply of 3.5 billion litres of water.
